attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Kansas corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Kansas Corporate Filing Requirement Check Started" job.audit_trail swap addto false result.ks_has_nexus xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus threshold ($100K gross receipts or 200 transactions); result.ks_gross_receipts is greater than or equal to result.ks_economic_nexus_threshold

action_details.action_postfix: // No nexus - no filing required false result.ks_has_nexus xdef 0.0 result.ks_tax_liability xdef "Kansas filing not required: No nexus with state" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Kansas state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. KS requires addback of federal interest income and state income tax refunds, with subtraction of Kansas municipal bond interest.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Kansas Corporate Income Adjustments Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 result.ks_state_additions xdef 0.0 result.ks_state_subtractions xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Kansas state additions and subtractions; Calculate state-specific income adjustments

action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 result.ks_state_additions xdef 0.0 result.ks_state_subtractions xdef "Kansas adjustments not calculated: No nexus" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Kansas corporate income tax. Applies Kansas two-tier rate (4.0% base + 3.0% surtax on income over $50K) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Kansas Corporate Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 result.ks_taxable_income xdef 0.0 result.ks_base_tax xdef 0.0 result.ks_surtax xdef 0.0 result.ks_tax_liability xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive taxable income; result.ks_apportioned_income is greater than 0
Income exceeds $50,000 surtax threshold; result.ks_taxable_income is greater than result.ks_surtax_threshold

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Kansas tax with base rate + surtax (income over $50K); Apply 4.0% base + 3.0% surtax on income over $50K
Calculate Kansas tax - income $50K or less (base rate only); Apply only 4.0% base rate
No taxable income - no tax liability
action_details.action_postfix: // No taxable income - no tax liability 0.0 result.ks_taxable_income xdef 0.0 result.ks_tax_liability xdef result.ks_estimated_payments result.ks_refund_or_owed xdef "Kansas tax liability: $0 (no taxable income)" job.audit_trail swap addto

// No nexus - no tax liability 0.0 result.ks_taxable_income xdef 0.0 result.ks_tax_liability xdef result.ks_estimated_payments result.ks_refund_or_owed xdef "Kansas tax liability: $0 (no nexus)" job.audit_trail swap addto
